title: plugin-security: RLS membership staging is marked done before the resolver answers, so a concurrent read on the same context can compile against an empty membership bag
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1D3AzXvEhBbz79Pmi

Loose end of #33051 (PR #33303, landed). Not measured: read from the code while tracing step 2.6.

## Problem

`stageResolverMembership` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-rls-filter.ts`) sets `context.__rlsMembershipStaged = true` before it awaits the membership resolver. A second operation running concurrently on the same execution context (a record page's related slices, stream or timeline parts) sees the flag, skips staging, and can compile `current_user.KEY` row-level policies against a membership bag that is not filled yet. That fails closed: the second read returns fewer rows than it should. Reachable only when an RLS membership resolver is registered and no earlier operation in the request has staged.

## Do

- Pin it first: two concurrent reads on one context with a resolver that resolves after a tick; the second read's rows must equal the same read alone.
- Then make the staging await-safe (e.g. store the in-flight promise and have later operations await it, instead of a boolean set before the await).
- Control: one read alone, and sequential reads, unchanged.

Suggested-grade: p3 (fail closed, under-fill only). lane: `domain:server` · area A3.

Dedupe words: rlsMembershipStaged, concurrent, fail closed, membership resolver, staging flag before await.
